About BC Services

Established 2009. Johannesburg.

A trusted partner in the care of your property

Every property deserves a thorough, dependable standard of cleanliness. BC Services was founded in 2009 to deliver exactly that, quality, reliable and worry-free cleaning, to homes and businesses across Johannesburg.

Our technicians are thoroughly trained to clean, deodorise and protect carpeting professionally and safely. We combine careful up-front preparation with disciplined on-site procedures, so you can count on the result you want, every time.

Our commitment does not end when the work is done. We remain available to answer your questions and to advise on any further service you may need.
